Venezuela Talks Yield Judicial Reform and Frozen Funds Agreement

Venezuela's interim government and opposition concluded their initial round of talks on Wednesday, reaching agreements on reforming the Supreme Tribunal of Justice and accessing frozen funds. The parties aim to use these funds, held at the Bank of England, to finance recovery efforts following devastating earthquakes in June. The talks focused on these two key areas, as detailed in a joint statement.
